query: Our checkout returns an internal server error 500 after deployment.

RB-001.text: Inspect application error logs around the failed request and correlate request IDs.
Compare the first error timestamp with deployment and configuration changes.
Inspect the failing dependency and exception type; do not assume every 500 has the same cause.

query: The application processor is at 99 percent and CPU throttling is rising.

RB-002.text: Compare CPU usage, request rate and latency over the same interval.
Identify the process or container consuming CPU using existing monitoring.
Inspect throttling, hot code paths and recent workload changes before proposing capacity changes.

query: Postgres SQL queries exceed the query deadline.

RB-003.text: Separate connection acquisition time from query execution time using traces.
Inspect database activity for long-running queries and wait events.
Compare slow query fingerprints and database resource metrics against the incident window.

query: The container ran out of memory and was OOMKilled.

RB-004.text: Compare resident memory and configured container memory limits.
Inspect termination reasons and events for evidence of OOM termination.
Review memory growth against traffic and recent releases; distinguish a sudden peak from sustained growth.

query: Service hostname lookups return NXDOMAIN.

RB-005.text: Identify the exact hostname, namespace and resolution error without collecting credentials.
Review resolver configuration and compare the expected service name with service discovery records.
Inspect DNS service health and existing DNS logs for the same failure window.

query: API p99 response time increased although requests still succeed.

RB-006.text: Compare p50, p95 and p99 latency with the baseline and request volume.
Inspect distributed traces to separate application time from dependency time.
Review resource saturation and recent releases for the slowest endpoint.

query: Customers get HTTP 503 and the service has no healthy endpoints.

RB-007.text: Review the service endpoint list and backend readiness state.
Inspect workload events and health check failures during the outage.
Compare desired and available replicas and correlate with deployment events.

query: The reverse proxy returns 502 bad gateway for upstream responses.

RB-008.text: Identify which proxy generated the 502 from existing response metadata.
Inspect gateway logs for upstream connection or response errors.
Compare upstream health, ports and protocol configuration with the expected route.

query: The gateway reports HTTP 504 while waiting on the backend.

RB-009.text: Review gateway timing logs to identify the slow upstream.
Compare upstream response duration with the configured gateway deadline.
Inspect dependency latency and request traces before considering timeout changes.

query: Writes fail with no space left on the filesystem.

RB-010.text: Inspect filesystem capacity and inode usage in existing host monitoring.
Identify growth in logs, temporary files and application data from storage reports.
Check retention policies and ownership before requesting any cleanup.

query: Clients report an expired TLS certificate during handshake.

RB-011.text: Inspect the presented certificate expiry, hostname coverage and chain using approved diagnostics.
Compare the client clock and trust configuration with expected settings.
Review certificate deployment records to identify missing or stale intermediate certificates.

query: Protected API requests return 401 after a token expires.

RB-012.text: Review the response authentication challenge and redacted authentication logs.
Check token expiry and intended audience through approved identity tooling without pasting the token.
Compare the authentication configuration with the identity provider settings.

query: An authenticated user receives 403 permission denied.

RB-013.text: Identify the rejected operation and resource category.
Compare assigned roles with the documented access policy using approved access records.
Review authorization audit events and recent policy changes.

query: Our clients get HTTP 429 too many requests after a burst.

RB-014.text: Inspect rate limit response metadata and any Retry-After value.
Compare request volume and client retry patterns with configured quotas.
Review whether retries amplify traffic and document the affected client category.

query: Kubernetes shows CrashLoopBackOff and the container keeps restarting.

RB-015.text: Inspect previous termination reason, exit code and restart count.
Review previous container logs and workload events around the first exit.
Compare entrypoint and non-secret configuration with the last working deployment.

query: Pods show ImagePullBackOff when fetching an image from the registry.

RB-016.text: Inspect workload events for missing image, registry access or network errors.
Compare the image name and tag with the release manifest.
Review registry availability and credential reference configuration without reading credential values.

query: A running pod is not ready because its readiness probe fails.

RB-017.text: Review readiness probe events, path, port and timeout settings.
Inspect application startup and dependency health at the same time.
Compare probe settings with the application health endpoint contract.

query: Every database connection is busy and callers wait for the pool.

RB-018.text: Compare active, idle and waiting pool connections with configured limits.
Inspect database sessions and transaction age to identify long-held connections.
Compare request concurrency with pool capacity and application connection lifecycle metrics.

query: Postgres transactions wait on locks held by another session.

RB-019.text: Inspect lock monitoring and correlate waiting sessions with database activity.
Identify blocking transaction age and the affected relation using approved monitoring.
Review transaction boundaries and concurrent workload changes without cancelling sessions.

query: TCP connections to the application port are immediately refused.

RB-020.text: Verify the expected destination port and service-to-container port mapping.
Review listener status from existing telemetry and compare backend readiness.
Inspect network and service events for a stopped process or incorrect route.

query: Network traffic has packet loss and TCP retransmissions.

RB-021.text: Compare network error and retransmission metrics with the incident timeline.
Identify whether failures share a node, zone or destination.
Review interface health and recent network policy changes from existing records.

query: Pod events show FailedMount for a persistent volume claim.

RB-022.text: Inspect workload and volume events for attachment or mount errors.
Review claim binding status, storage class and volume availability.
Compare access modes and node placement with the storage requirements.

query: How do I bake a chocolate cake?
Who won the football match?
Write a wedding poem.
How do I reset a forgotten VPN password?
How do I restore a deleted database backup?
What is the stock price today?
